metaDescription: From structure prediction to designed binders and biocatalysts.
heroTitle: From structure prediction to designed binders and biocatalysts backbone to sequence.
heroDescription: Structure prediction and generative design models the same class of tools recognized by the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for computational protein design now take a program from a target structure to a designed binder, therapeutic protein, or novel enzyme in silico before the first bench experiment. We build and validate these pipelines for your application: antibodies and peptides, or industrial biocatalysts with improved activity, stability, or substrate specificity.
capabilities: Structure prediction and generative backbone design for novel proteins
Binder and antibody design workflows, from target structure to candidate sequences
Enzyme engineering for improved activity, stability, or substrate specificity
In silico validation before committing to bench synthesis
relatedText: Designed proteins and enzymes often feed directly into cell factory engineering.
